C0422.title: Zhejiang Tailong Bank's Aggregate Payment App 'TaiHuiShou' Flagged for Unauthorized Personal Data Collection
C0422.summary: On November 30, 2023, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) named 22 apps violating user rights, including Zhejiang Tailong Commercial Bank's aggregate payment app 'TaiHuiShou' for unauthorized collection of personal information and excessive permission requests.
